HRA Analysis: TWILIGHT STORM (1) gets back to the pole draw, where she is two from two in her career. She should have enough gate speed to kick up early and hold the front, giving her every chance to notch another win on the board. REMMINGTON (7) beat the above runner last start when able to lead and has been racing in good form. He will have to do it tougher here from the wide draw and find a spot on speed, but you can't knock winning form and he looks the main danger. SUMTHIN ELSE (2) should drop in behind the polemarker and get its chance up the sprint lane after putting in a handy enough effort first up in the state. COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (4) and MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (5) returned to form with handy efforts last start, although this looks a slight rise in grade, so they may require a couple of the favoured runners to get into a battle to be finishing past them. Selections:TWILIGHT STORM (1), REMMINGTON (7), SUMTHIN ELSE (2), COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (4) Staking Strategy:TWILIGHT STORM gets her chance to get back in the winner’s circle with the pole draw advantage. 3 unit win – TWILIGHT STORM (1).

An even field of two-year-olds comes together for the No More Than One Win event, where DARCY BE DREAMING (9) returns from a good break after winning on debut earlier this season. He has trialled up nicely enough and, with a handy trailing back-row draw behind what looks a good beginner, should be able to position somewhere midfield in the running line and be running home strongly. MYSTERY MAIL (10) has produced some very strong performances while doing work in fast time throughout his career to date. While he still looks to be learning how to race, he appears to have plenty of ability and will only need to put his best foot forward to be running home strongly here. STABLE TALK (8) showed good promise in his first preparation and should be right in the finish if the gaps come his way from the inside back-row draw. ANN PENNY (2) is first up from New Zealand after some competitive efforts in metropolitan company. Her trials since arriving in the state have been good enough to suggest she could take some running down if able to find the pegs, where she looks to possess sharp gate speed when asked. HEZA PINUP BOY (4) and VINCENT THE THIRD (5) look to have some ability, although both strike awkward draws here. BETTOR CALL LOU (6) has put together some nice trial efforts since his debut run, where he broke, and could be the one at odds from the wide draw if he can secure a good run in transit. Selections:ANN PENNY (2), MYSTERY MAIL (10), DARCY BE DREAMING (9), STABLE TALK (8) Staking Strategy: With the advantage of the barrier draw over her more fancied rivals, ANN PENNY looks to get her chance to win first up on Australian soil. 2 unit win – ANN PENNY (2).

OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (1) draws the pole over the mile and, with his handy gate speed coming off a strong performance last start, you would expect he could take some running down in this field. He may cop some early pressure from COLORADO GIRL (7), who possesses very sharp gate speed when asked, but the remainder of the front row only look to have moderate gate speed. A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (3) has been okay since arriving in the state and, if she is able to settle better than she did last start, she should be right in the finish. The remainder of the field is an even bunch, where QUEEN ANASTASIA (2) has been somewhat disappointing this season after putting together some nice placings in feature races last year. If she brings her best form from the nice draw, she could be the one at each-way odds running over the top late. Selections:OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (1), QUEEN ANASTASIA (2), A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (3), COLORADO GIRL (7) Staking Strategy:QUEEN ANASTASIA should get a nice run behind the speed here. 1 unit win – QUEEN ANASTASIA (2).

The second division of the No More Than One Win horses is over the mile, where WINNING BREW (3) will be looking to get back into the winner's circle after some handy performances of late against somewhat stronger fields than she meets here. Expect him to be driven forward from the gate and attempt to find the pegs, although GEMMY LOU (1) does possess sharp gate speed when required. She resumes first up for the new stable and should also be suited by the short-distance journey. COMINSKI LEIS (5) looks an improving type, and his last effort two months ago, when doing the work outside the leader and battling on for fourth against a very strong field, would be good enough to take this out if fit enough first up from the let-up. It wouldn't surprise to see any of the runners in this field bob up and win with the right run in transit, including TISU SUNNY (6) who is more than capable if he bring his best manners. Selections:WINNING BREW (3), COMINSKI LEIS (5), TISU SUNNY (6), GEMMY LOU (1) Staking Strategy:WINNING BREW should settle on speed and deserves to break through after some handy performances of late. 2 unit win – WINNING BREW (3).

ALOT LIKE PENDLES (1) resumes from nearly five months off and draws the pole for his return. He is clearly the most progressive horse in this field and should be fit enough after a strong recent trial in preparation for his return. OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (4) won well first up in the state when leading over the mile. There looks to be some okay gate speed drawn to her inside today, so her chances may be reliant on where she is able to settle in the run, but she looks the main danger to the expected favourite. COUNTY COURT JUDGE (2) is first up in the state and, prior to his Tamworth racing, had some handy Queensland and New South Wales form that would make him more than competitive here from the nice draw. CHEYS ANGEL (7) is going for three straight and has been quite impressive in both wins since rejoining her old camp. She will be relying on some good speed throughout and a nice cart into the race to allow her to finish strongly again. KENYA (10) continues to run honest races and will no doubt be put into the race from the back row, which should ensure an even tempo throughout. Selections:ALOT LIKE PENDLES (1), OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (4), COUNTY COURT JUDGE (2), CHEYS ANGEL (7) Staking Strategy:ALOT LIKE PENDLES should get every chance from the pole draw. 3 unit win – ALOT LIKE PENDLES (1).

The low-class race tonight as usual brings together an even bunch, where KYRGIOS (5) will be looking to find a spot on speed after a strong performance last week when second after copping pressure through a 27.3 first quarter. QUEENOFDANCE (12) is going for three straight victories and will be reliant on some good speed throughout to allow her to run home strongly again here. DANCINGWIVJOLENE (2) should be fitter second up from a break and gets the ideal draw to sit on speed and get her chance to be in the finish, as does BARBETTE (3), who is consistently earning cheques in this grade without winning often and should use her handy gate speed to also find a spot on speed. It wouldn't surprise to see any of the other runners in the field bob up and win with the right run in transit. Selections:KYRGOIS (5), QUEENOFDANCE (12), DANCINGWIVJOLENE (2), BARBETTE (3) Staking Strategy: Looks to be enough speed on early here to allow QUEENOFDANCE to again be running home strongly at each-way odds. 1 unit each-way – QUEENOFDANCE (12).

The front row has numerous runners with solid gate speed but no clear standout, making this a tricky map to assess. ROCKY STRIDE (5) continues to run great races without winning but again draws an awkward gate. IDEN OLIVER (1) and ART HUNTSMAN (4) have the winning form on the board and continue to rise in grade, but should land nice positions on speed from their handy draws, as should MERRYWOOD PAUL (2) who has been thereabouts of late without winning. GOODTIME OSCAR (6) will no doubt be put into the race at some point, as he usually is, which should ensure a solid tempo throughout. The back-row runners will be relying on that speed up front to allow them to run home strongly, including UNMATCHED (8), who draws a tricky gate but could be flashing home late if the gaps come his way after being super competitive in the recent Raider Stakes Final and Beautide field. Selections:UNMATCHED (8), ROCKY STRIDE (5), IDEN OLIVER (1), ART HUNTSMAN (4) Staking Strategy: A tricky inside back-row draw, but if he sees any clear running, UNMATCHED will be running home strongly. 1 unit each way – UNMATCHED (8).

TREACHEROUS DAN (1) is a three-year-old resuming from a slight let-up and looks a promising type. However, the pole draw is probably the one he didn't want, especially with some handy gate-speed horses in SHADES OF SILK (2) and LAID BACK (5) drawn to his outside. Even if he doesn't hold the front, as I suspect, you would think he gets his chance up the sprint lane and should be right in the finish. RAINBOW RANGER (4) is another handy three-year-old who will be looking to find a nice spot on speed with cover, which should give him every chance first up from a break. MUZZAME MATE (6) draws an awkward gate over the short distance, so tactics will be interesting early, but you can't discount his class. It is hard to see the back-row runners beating the favoured front-row horses unless they overdo it early, which would bring the likes of IDEN LADY LINCOLN (10) and SHOOBEES SPIRIT (12) into the race late. Selections:RAINBOW RANGER (4), TREACHEROUS DAN (1), MUZZAME MATE (6), SHADES OF SILK (2) Staking Strategy: Looks to be speed aplenty here over the short distance, where RAINBOW RANGER, first up, should sit just off the speed in the one-out line and get his chance to run home strongly if fit enough. 2 unit win – RAINBOW RANGER (4).

The open-class field of the night, where WATERMELON SUGAR (1) will again be looking for an all-the-way victory using his sharp gate speed. Expect WAVES OF CHANCE (4) to push forward from his middle front-row draw and sit on speed, while HORATIUS SPECULO (3) should look to land on his back and secure the ideal one-one position, giving him every chance to sprint quickly late. MAEBEE (8) was back in the winner's circle last week with a strong performance and should get a nice cushy run behind the expected leader, giving him his chance up the sprint lane if he can repeat that effort. GO THE RED (6) looks the best of the rest and will be relying on some solid tempo throughout to allow him to run home into the finish from his awkward draw. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (3), MAEBEE (8), WAVES OF CHANCE (4), WATERMELON SUGAR (1) Staking Strategy: Hard to go past HORATIUS SPECULO, who should get a nice sit on the speed and clearly is most upside horse in this field. 2 unit win – HORATIUS SPECULO (3).

The night rounds out with a stand-start event over the long distance, where MOVESLIKEALADY (1) has her first attempt behind the tapes. She began brilliantly in a trial at Carrick earlier in the week and, although she is known to be quite a handful from the mobiles, hopefully it may be the opposite here. A safe beginning will take her a long way in this field. SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (2) is a sharp beginner and should get his chance, although this is stronger than what he has been competing against lately. WE SALUTE YOU (6) is always running home strongly in these sorts of fields, while BAIL DENIED (7) also has his first stand-start attempt but has been in super form since arriving in the state. If he steps safely away, as he did when qualifying at the trials, he could take some holding out late. Selections:BAIL DENIED (7), MOVESLIKEALADY (1), WE SALUTE YOU (6), SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (2) Staking Strategy:BAIL DENIED looks the value play of the race. 2 unit win - BAIL DENIED (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

UP THE BOMBER (3) is drawn well and has shown some nice ability at the trials. If he can find the lead early he will be hard to catch. ANGRYPANTS ANGIE (6) is a big threat as well and has also been showing ability at the trials. JUST MILZY (5) and IMNOLOVEANBUSINESS (1) are also chances.

JILLIBY BLISS (3) was narrowly beaten at Kapunda last start off a twenty meter handicap. She will prefer being back here at Globe Derby today along with the mobile start. She is a good chance of leading all of the way. EMILY MEGAN (5), MAGICAL MADGE (2) and REHAB LAD (1) are also chances.

OHSO KINKY (7) has a tough draw to overcome but she can win over this distance. She ran a handy race first up last week and she looks like a strong winning chance today. JAWSOFGOODTIME (2) should find the lead today and run a strong race but the distance will be a concern for her. TRIGGER (4) and MANDS PEARL (3) are also chances.

RESURRECTS (3) ran a very nice race behind ROCKNROLL SPIRIT last start when he was beaten by a short half head. He is a strong chance today in a race like this. LINXX (6), TWO WAY WONDER (2) and UPRIGHT (1) are also chances.

STORMY MADEM (7) was a galloper last start but if she can pace smoothly today for Ryan Hryhorec then she finds such a winnable race if she is anywhere near her best. OAKLANDER (6) is drawn awkwardly but he is another who could run a very strong race today if he is anywhere near his best. BERSAGLIERE (3) and MY ULTIMATE BANJO (1) are also chances.

JACKIE DANIELS (4) ran fourth at Globe Derby last start and third at Gawler the start prior. She has the ability to take this sort of race out if she is anywhere near her best. Today looks easier for her. ROAD STAR (8), PARADIGM (2) and MIKISPUR (3) are also chances.

BITOFDUTCHCOURAGE (1) gets the best draw he has had for a while. If he leads then he should lead all of the way. ALWAYSBEALADY (5) looks like a big threat after a strong win at Globe Derby last start when she defeated TONKAWAIKON by a half head. FLY THE BANNER (9) and DEE JAYS MISS (4) are also chances.

SRIRACHA (9) was a massive winner at Kapunda last start when he defeated JUST MOCHA by 25.5 meters. He looks extremely hard to beat today even with the second row draw. FEARFULL DRAGON (4), RIVERGUM VELOX (3) and PARISIAN BANDIT (1) are also chances.

LOCHINVAR RULER (11) was very impressive last start when he led all of the way and defeated BRUZER by 8.3 meters. If he gains a start as the first emergency today then he will be hard to beat. DASHING COWBOY (2), BRUZER (10), CAPTAINS DREAM (1) and GIANT JACKSON (6) are all big chances in what is a very tricky race. DARK AND HANDSOME (4) returns in this race having not raced since late July. He was a good winner two starts ago at Marburg leading all the way and rating good time there. He looks hard to beat. HYPNOTIZE ME (5) took on a much stronger race last time out where he held the lead and was well beaten in tenth. He should find this a lot more suitable and can secure a more economical run off the speed this time. DOUG STEWART (2) should secure a good run in this race close to the speed. He wasn’t beaten too far first up behind Denis The Punter in fourth before taking on a stronger race and being well beaten there. LACEYS LASS (6) secured the ideal run leaders back three starts ago and was able to sprint best to score. She draws poorly on return and may need a few things to go her way. SELECTIONS: DARK AND HANDSOME (4), HYPNOTIZE ME (5), DOUG STEWART (2), LACEYS LASS (6) SUGGESTED BET: DARK AND HANDSOME (4) to win.

MY ULTIMATE LEO (4) secured a good run two starts ago and was running on late into third. He was well supported in markets last time out and never looked likely when getting back and running sixth. This race looks more suitable. STORMY MIDNIGHT (8) got back last time out and was running on late into fourth in a race taken out by Mcrockin. He should get a similar run in this race and looks suited in this field. TEN AND TWO (6) ran well recently at Marburg when finishing third two starts ago behind Azzif. He draws poorly outside the front row in this race but does find a race without a lot of depth. MELTON FOURHUNDRED (3) was forced to race without cover two starts ago and battled on reasonably there finishing seventh. He should secure a more economical run in this race and can be thereabouts. SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE LEO (4), STORMY MIDNIGHT (8), TEN AND TWO (6), MELTON FOURHUNDRED (3) SUGGESTED BET: STORMY MIDNIGHT (8) to win.

DRAKAINA (7) wasn’t beaten far last time out at Albion Park in a much stronger race than this one which was taken out by Powermove. She draws awkwardly inside the back row and will need to navigate into the clear at some stage but does look to have strong claims in this race. GHOST TRAIN (8) led last time out over the 2040 at Redcliffe when appearing to have his chance there finishing third. He may be suited by the soft trailing draw in this race and could also be suited by the slight step back in distance. RAINBOW GAMBLER (9) sat without cover and battled on well last time out finishing third behind Stones and The Black Fox. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. ICANANDIWILL (2) has good gate speed and may look to press forward and lead in the early stages of this race from a good draw. She led three starts ago and was wlel beaten but seemingly finds a much easier race. SELECTIONS: DRAKAINA (7), GHOST TRAIN (8), RAINBOW GAMBLER (9), ICANANDIWILL (2) SUGGESTED BET: DRAKAINA (7) to win.

MY ULTIMATE LOUIE (1) is a horse that just loves to lead in his races and appears likely to get that opportunity from a good draw. He got back in the run last time out at Marburg and couldn’t get into the race there taken out by Stones. MAJOR GENERALJUJON (7) looks likely to get a good run through early in this race behind a gate speed. He finished fourth last time out in a stronger race which was taken out by October Racketeer at Marburg. ILLBEWATCHING (6) draws poorly in this race having recently bounced back to form when leading and beating his stablemate Diamond Deano. He may be shuffled back or could be forced to do some work which makes things tricky on paper. GOOD WORD THAT (2) was shuffled back on the pegs last time out before running on fairly late. He looks likely to secure a good run close to the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE LOUIE (1), MAJOR GENERALJUJON (7), ILLBEWATCHING (6), GOOD WORD THAT (2) SUGGESTED BET: MY ULTIMATE LOUIE (1) to win.

HOLME BOY (5) was a dominant winner running over the top four starts ago at Marburg to win by a big margin. He looks likely to get a good run off the speed again in this race and if the race is run to suit he should be running on late. COOL DUDE JOEY (9) over raced fiercely last timeout at Marburg when beaten a long way there. If he can settle this time he looks to have strong claims in what appears to be a race he is well graded in. JILLIBY PANDA (2) was able to lead and win four starts ago at Marburg and hasn’t had a lot of luck since. He looks likely to be able to lead again in this race and can prove hard to run down. CHEDDAR MADE BETA (1) sat behind the leader two starts ago and wasn’t beaten far there. He looks set to get a similar run in this race and shouldn’t be too far away. SELECTIONS: HOLME BOY (5), COOL DUDE JOEY (9), JILLIBY PANDA (2), CHEDDAR MADE BETA (1) SUGGESTED BET: CHEDDAR MADE BETA (1) each way.

LETHAL LOUIE (7) didn’t have a lot of luck last time out when finishing eighth at Albion Park when not beaten far. He looks set to get an ideal run through in the early stages and should be dangerous late if he can get into the clear at the right time. DUAL CAM (8) sat without cover two starts ago and battled on well for fourth in a race taken out by his stablemate ONE LAST ROLL (4). He should get a good run through early in this race and can be put into the race again if the tempo permits. He should be hard to beat in this company. DIEGO DELGADO (1) was able to drive through and lead last time out and was taken on strongly by The Tiger Army there when battling on well for third. He should be able to drive through and lead again which should give him every chance. ONE LAST ROLL (4) secured the ideal run last time out behind the leader at Albion Park and was able to drive through and score there over the 2138. He draws awkwardly in this race but is rarely far away. SELECTIONS: LETHAL LOUIE (7), DUAL CAM (8), DIEGO DELGADO (1), ONE LAST ROLL (4) SUGGESTED BET: LETHAL LOUIE (7) to win. OVERVIEW:REGAL GALA (1) has enjoyed a terrific season having won four races. He followed a handy second in the Super Series Final with a win in the Tatlow Stakes so he will prove hard to beat. PHOENIX REX (5) produced a phenomenal performance after being severely checked on the first bend and coming from tailed off to win the Qbred Triad Final at Albion Park. He hasn’t been at his best form in two starts since returning to Victoria but he is extremely smart when he puts it altogether and he is the only horse in this race that has competed from the standing start previously. MAJARO GIRL (8) showed brilliant gate speed to lead, took cover and tried hard when second in the Tatlow Stakes last outing. She was a dominant winner in a mile rate of 1.58.8 at Melton prior and is worth an investment. KYVALLEY DIXON (6) produced a big finish to claim victory in the Super Series Final two starts ago prior to a fourth in the Tatlow Stakes. She is a classy filly and must be respected. INSULATOR (2) jumped to the front from the standing start when he won a trial at Melton on Tuesday so he rates as a value hope. SELECTIONS: REGAL GALA (1), PHOENIX REX (5), MAJARO GIRL (8), KYVALLEY DIXON (6)

OVERVIEW:MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7) has done very well at her two starts to date and deserves to break through for a win. She raced without cover throughout and went down fighting when a close second at Ballarat on debut then held her own in a fast final quarter of 27.9 seconds at her latest third. CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (6) began very quickly from a similar wide draw to find the lead when a close second behind Tombeur at Cranbourne last outing. He has been runner up in five of his seven starts to date and should give another forward showing. SWIM SUIT (8) was resuming since April when he worked home fairly well for fourth at Horsham on Monday. He should be fitter from that performance and is capable of running into a place. AMADA VILLMA (9) missed out narrowly after trying to lead throughout at Charlton two starts ago and has claims. The former New South Wales pacer KELLYS COMMOTION (10) was heavily supported but galloped when on debut at Newcastle so she must be kept safe. BACK: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7), CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (6), SWIM SUIT (8), AMADA VILLMA (9)

OVERVIEW: BETSY ANNE (6) possesses early speed and strikes a very suitable assignment here. She trailed the leader, was held up for a run at a vital stage and worked into third via the sprint lane at Kilmore last outing. TOUCHANDGO (5) didn’t have much luck when seventh at Ballarat last outing but his two efforts prior were sound and he is worth thought under these conditions. MISS AVENGER (2) settled on the markers, angled out three horses wide from the 600m and ran home fairly well for fourth when resuming at Kilmore. She should be fitter from that run and is worth a ticket each way. WHATSTHEGOSS (10) is a maiden from 31 starts but he has the ability to win races if he can mend his manners. He finished off well via an inside run when third at Ballarat two starts ago and could feature prominently if he delivers a fool proof display. BACK: BETSY ANNE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BETSY ANNE (6), TOUCHANDGO (5), MISS AVENGER (2), WHATSTHEGOSS (10)

OVERVIEW: CASTLES IN THE SKY (7) was having her first run since February without going to the trials when she attempted to lead throughout and battled on well for third behind Connies President at Horsham on Monday. She should have derived a lot of benefit from that run and is a good chance of working across with NEDZA THRILLER (6) early before finding the top shortly afterwards so she must be included amongst the leading chances. NEDZA THRILLER (6) led out then took cover when second behind the in-form trotter Boutika at Charlton then attempted to lead throughout when second at Ballarat. He appears to be the fastest beginner on the front line and should give another bold showing. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (10) has been finding the line nicely at his most recent performances and strikes a suitable assignment now so he warrants consideration. CHARLIE WALKER (8) performed below expectations when sixth behind Money Talks at Kilmore last outing but he led throughout at a Ballarat victory on September 02 so he is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: CASTLES IN THE SKY (7), NEDZA THRILLER (6), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (10), CHARLIE WALKER (8)

OVERVIEW: The manners of PURPLE MOON (6) will be the key to the result of this event. She galloped away and made up many lengths when a huge second behind Joe Lou three starts ago then broke stride at her next two attempts. She is clearly the horse to beat if she delivers a fool proof display. THE CHOOK (7) settled in the second half of the field and worked home well when second behind Aldebaran Denbay last outing. She is usually competitive against this class and looms as one of the leading chances again. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4) did well to score at Ballarat last outing after she parked on the outside of the leader throughout. She is likely to obtain a prominent position in the early stages and is worth thought again. SNICKERS EXPRESS (3) has been placed in six of his past seven starts and deserves to break through for a win. He did appear to have his chance when third at Ballarat last time out but this race is no harder so he is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: PURPLE MOON (6), THE CHOOK (7), CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (4), SNICKERS EXPRESS (3)

OVERVIEW:ANTONOV (11) faces the back mark of 20m but he is a standing start specialist and is very versatile. He followed successive Maryborough victories with a sixth against strong opposition in the Geelong Cup last outing. NEPHEW OF SONOKO (10) ran a much sharper race when he dashed through the middle late and finished in fourth at Cranbourne last week. He has only been placed once this season but his last run was encouraging and this is his easiest assignment for some time. CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (3) has commenced from big handicaps at his past two attempts and has performed strongly. He moves to the front line now and must be respected. BOUTIKA (1) continues to step up in grade but she has never raced better and is drawn to receive every chance. She pushed forward to find the lead and scored comfortably in a standing start event at Charlton last outing. SELECTIONS: ANTONOV (11), NEPHEW OF SONOKO (10), CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (3), BOUTIKA (1)

OVERVIEW: ASMILEANDAWINX (10) prefers to race close to the speed so the barrier draw is a disadvantage but she is clearly the class runner of the field. She competed in a Metropolitan event when fifth at Geelong last week and she recorded mile rates of 1.55.1 and 1.55.7 in two recent Maryborough victories. ASSIGNED (9) worked to the front, backed off the tempo mid-race and finished off in slick final sectionals when he won at Kilmore on September 17. He took on a strong field at Shepparton last time out and appears to be much better placed against this class. ARTIST (2) is a brilliant beginner and is the likely leader. He worked hard to lead from a wide draw and had excuses at Ballarat last outing so he is worth another chance. ANIMADO (6) was placed at Melton behind Hiltons Spirit on September 09 and is better than his numerical form suggests. He is a possible improver under these conditions. SELECTIONS: ASMILEANDAWINX (10), ASSIGNED (9), ARTIST (2), ANIMADO (6)

OVERVIEW: RANGER RICK (9), is a consistent pacer, which missed out narrowly behind Keayang Payton at Geelong two starts ago and followed with a fourth at Geelong, where he led out, took cover and was shuffled back on the markers. This event appears to be easier and he should run his usual honest race. STEEL THE MOMENT (6) was resuming since July when he was headed off at the start and was buried away on the markers at his latest handy finishing sixth behind Ultimate Vinnie. He should have benefited from that run and strikes a suitable assignment here. IMAGINATION ORO (2) progressed forward to find the lead and dominated her rivals when she scored in a mile rate of 1.56.3 at Terang. She is meeting a field of more depth now but she is drawn to give another forward showing. KATUNGA EXPRESS (8) will need luck from the inside of the second line but he ran a game race for third at Ballarat last week and is not without a chance. BACK: RANGER RICK (9) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: RANGER RICK (9), STEEL THE MOMENT (6), IMAGINATION ORO (2), KATUNGA EXPRESS (8)

OVERVIEW: JUSTLIKEDAVE (7) got a long way back from a similar wide draw and finished off hard when third behind Roblen Demon at Cranbourne last week. He was driven aggressively mid-race and put in a career best performance when a runaway winner at Cranbourne three starts ago and he looms as one of the leading chances again. TORQUE IN HEAVEN (6) is racing in peak form and should be competitive again. He has been defeated by Yankee Rain at his past two runner up performances but both times he finished strongly so he is capable of going one better here. TED BEAR (10) settled in the second half of the field and finished off solidly when second behind Our Pinup Girl in a mile rate of 1.55.7 at Ballarat last outing. He is starting to hit his peak form and should be finishing off nicely again. REGAL ROCK (4) is a fast beginner and races best when he is able to lead over the sprint distance so he has the conditions to suit him here. He pushed forward to find the lead and was run down over the final stages when third behind Wingate Guy last outing. BACK: JUSTLIKEDAVE (7) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: JUSTLIKEDAVE (7), TORQUE IN HEAVEN (6), TED BEAR (10), REGAL ROCK (4)

OVERVIEW:MAJOR ORION (5) has been good in his runs for the Douglas stable, performing well from tricky draws and set-ups. He attempted to lead here last week unsuccessfully and sat parked thereafter in quick time for this grade. The map looks more favourable to cross to the pegs this time and find the top, and from there he’ll take plenty of catching. ELIZAJANE (7) has been racing well this season and, despite the wide draw, is likely to press forward over the short trip. Whether she has the speed to lead is questionable, but even if she sits parked, she is well placed and can hang tough. WICKED MITZI (8) isn’t in great numerical form but gets a soft run from the back row here, and with Herbertson booked becomes a blowout hope if the breaks come. INTERPRETATION (9) drops in grade, and the Dembe form he’s been exposed to over his past couple of runs looks to be decent form. He was forced to sit parked last week and may be better coming with one run if the pace is right. BACK: MAJOR ORION (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MAJOR ORION (5), ELIZAJANE (7), WICKED MITZI (8), INTERPRETATION (9)

OVERVIEW: A standing start for the trotters here over the middle distance, which often makes it difficult for the backmarkers. However, the front-row brigade isn’t going all that well. STRAIGHT TO THETOP (7) loves the standing-start conditions and was a winner at this track and distance, from the same handicap, back in August against a similar line-up. She turned in a good run last week behind a smart one, and with the right run in transit can be strong late. KENNYS SON (9) is off a 30m handicap, but in his favour are sound standing-start manners and a win at this track. He was a winner here under mobile conditions two back, but the concern is that he broke in running either side of that. WATCH AND ACT (8) is the most reliable under these conditions, with 10 of his 14 wins coming from the tapes. He hasn’t won in 20 tries this season, however, but his manners will carry him a long way. KYVALLEY MISTY (3) gets the front-row advantage and has been okay from the stand in the past, but her run last start at Melton was not up to scratch. She was a winner in an easier race three back and gets Alford, so she’s worth keeping safe if you can overlook her last start. MASSIF CENTRAL (4) has only had the one standing start and, although beaten a long way, was quick away from the tapes. He’s a horse who likes to lead, but normally over the mile. He’s winless from 33 attempts at this distance but has place claims. BACK: STRAIGHT TO THETOP (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:STRAIGHT TO THETOP (7), KENNYS SON (9), WATCH AND ACT (8), KYVALLEY MISTY (3)

OVERVIEW: Tricky affair with little exposed form to draw upon with confidence. MYSTIC MOVER (7) is the exception to that observation, having placed in 3 of 5 starts, including a good 2nd last start at Kilmore behind an in-form winner. The gate is no spoil, but over the short trip and against an apparent lack of opposition, she may be obliged to press forward and give herself every chance. SON OF A BROAD (11) did plenty of work first up, but that’s normally the way he races and, to be fair, a bit more was expected. He does have a very in-form stable and driver, so be prepared to forgive last time and expect him to put his best foot forward here. Then there are a few runners who are a market watch and require a bit of guesswork. HOLLOW LOG (6) is an emergency and, interestingly, a well-bred 7yo first starter. He’s only had the one trial and showed great gate speed to finish 3rd, which was okay. He should be considered if he gets a run and is a market watch. ITS JUST RUBY (5) joins the Paul Tonkin stable, which often improves this type of horse fresh, so although the form isn’t there and she’s first up without a trial, she must be kept safe. The two stablemates, TAMALIA (2), who galloped away on debut, and EVA EXPRESS (3), haven’t done too much at the trials, but in fairness they were against better-rated types, and this stable is worth respecting. SELECTIONS:MYSTIC MOVER (7), SON OF A BROAD (11), HOLLOW LOG (6), ITS JUST RUBY (5)

OVERVIEW:MAJOR DRAMA (7) has been turning in some decent runs for the new stable, and she hasn’t had the best set-ups to put her best on display. She gets no favours with the draw, but this looks to be her most winnable race, dropping in class and looking well placed with the claim of in-form junior driver Blake Pace. She will need luck in running, but her second-last run was good enough to expect improvement. MADAM REACTOR (6) gets back to a more suitable grade, with some acceptable performances against tougher company. The map may be a bit sticky, but she looks well graded. PIRANI PERFECT (2) is a 3yo filly having her first run for the Rebecca Bartley stable, which deserves respect at its home track. She was a trial winner here recently and, from the positive draw, can race in a nice position. Her race form isn’t great, but any market push warrants attention. ROCK POSTER (4) is an honest mare who’s enjoying a solid season. She’s second up from a break and was good last time out when 3rd in the same race as the top pick. A positive draw helps her chances. It’s hard to know what to make of MIKIS PLEASURE (8) on current form, but she has won 3 from 12 starts, albeit with her best form coming a couple of years back. She’s had plenty of trials and is worth keeping safe for multiples. SELECTIONS:MAJOR DRAMA (7), MADAM REACTOR (6), PIRANI PERFECT (2), ROCK POSTER (4)

OVERVIEW:IMAWINGATE (5) is back to the grade he races best in, and his last victory in July came in similar grade with Herbertson aboard. He can slide forward alongside the likely leader and potentially find a good map. He’s a 10-time winner from 33 tries here, which is a much stronger record than many of these can boast. TREACHEROUSTIMES (4) looks the likely leader in the race and does race best from that position. He’s limited with the times he’s capable of, so if he gets control of the race, he will take some catching. BLUE CANNON (3) is an interesting runner, given that he’s been rough in his action this campaign, which is surprising for a horse of his experience. His best form has him well in this, so he’s worth keeping safe if he does everything right. Worth noting at the minor end are KRAKEY (6), ZEUSS (7) and MISTER RAUDONIKIS (8), who have drawn awkwardly and have been going fairly but would need to improve significantly to win. BACK: IMAWINGATE (5) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: IMAWINGATE (5), TREACHEROUSTIMES (4), BLUE CANNON (3), KRAKEY (6)

OVERVIEW:MELICAN (8) looks to be a 2yo filly going places, unbeaten in two race starts, the most recent of which saw her bolt in when able to lead. She goes to the back row now, but without a horse drawn outside her, she can map in a striking position. This is a tougher race and set-up, but hopefully that means a better price to play, as she looks the one to beat again. CRACKIN PHILTRA (5) is fresh up from a break off a couple of good trials and was good last preparation, winning before the spell in decent time. The trainer/driver combination deserves respect and should get the right map to have every chance. OZZIE TART (3) finished in the quinella behind the top pick last time but was beaten a long way. She has very good gate speed to get a good map and be a chance again. MAJOR FRIEND (6) was a good winner here last week in an easier race from a back-row draw. That performance keeps her in the mix, but this is a step up. THE KING OFTHEROAD (7) is first up and was racing well before a break. This draw and the quality of opposition mean a bit needs to go his way, so place claims look best. BACK: MELICAN (8) – 3.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: MELICAN (8), CRACKIN PHILTRA (5), OZZIE TART (3), MAJOR FRIEND (6)

OVERVIEW:YELLA (6) drops in grade for this and was good last week from a bad draw, where he drifted back to last and made good ground late. He can show speed, but it’s hard to know how the map plays out here. He’s going well enough to win again but will need luck in running. SHEZABLUECHIP (4) has a good strike rate at this track, with 50% of her wins coming here. She can show gate speed from this draw and be driven assertively to look for the front. She was a winner when on the peg line two back. ICANMOTOR (3) has been getting some ace steers from Jordy Leedham, but he just can’t seem to crack it for a win, although he has still been consistent. He can look to cross to the pegs and have options from there. JOEYS HANGOVER (5) didn’t have much luck here last week when dropping back to last after being caught wide. His runs have been sound this time in, and he has claims again. QUEENHIGH FLUSH (7) looks the only other hope for the Quaddie, and while she has ability and can give a good sight, the draw hurts. SELECTIONS: YELLA (6), SHEZABLUECHIP (4), ICANMOTOR (3), JOEYS HANGOVER (5)

OVERVIEW:OZZIE DIAMOND (8) is a 2yo filly giving away experience here, but she’s been good in her career so far, performing well in the Vicbred Series, and was a solid winner last time out at Kilmore, albeit from a better draw when she was able to map well. The claim gets her in well on the ratings scale, and if the tempo is solid enough, she can be strong late. LAVADA GOLD (2) was better last time out at Cranbourne when 2nd from a bad draw, finding the line strongly late along the inside. A better draw now and a repeat of that last run have him well in it. TASTE IT (4) has two wins and four minor placings from 19 starts this season. Glenn Bull gets a workable gate, and the horse has enough demonstrated ability for this type of grade. MISS PIGGY WIGGY (7) has three wins this season and a faster best mile rate, but gate seven makes the map challenging to overcome. Her best form warrants respect at this level, however. SELECTIONS:OZZIE DIAMOND (8), LAVADA GOLD (2), TASTE IT (4), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (7)
